acquisition.human_action_required: A Twilio operator must sign in to Twilio Console with an account that has organization access, open https://1console.twilio.com/organization/settings/oauth/apps, create an OAuth application using the Authorization code grant, enter Composio, the supplied description, homepage https://composio.dev, redirect URI https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add, and the required Twilio scopes, then copy the generated Client ID, Client Secret, and Authorization URL. Twilio's documented flow also asks for company name, Terms of Service URL, and application images; the Terms of Service URL and images were not provided. No form was submitted.

verification.result: OAuth endpoints and token endpoint are documented, but no client was obtained because the Console redirected to GitHub sign-in; no consent flow was completed.

packet.notes: Twilio documentation states organization OAuth apps support Authorization Code and Client Credentials. Authorization Code is the appropriate scheme for acting on behalf of a user. Twilio's OAuth metadata discovery found no RFC 7591 registration endpoint. The portal operator confirmed the flow is self-serve after authentication and was blocked at login.

alternatives.details: Twilio documents API keys and Account SID/Auth Token for REST API access; the user must provide the account credential. Nango independently lists Twilio as BASIC.

verification.result: Registration portal redirected to Slack sign-in and displayed 'Enter your email to sign in'; no client was created, so OAuth verification could not be performed.

acquisition.human_action_required: Provide a target ServiceNow customer or Personal Developer Instance and an operator/admin account with access to All > System OAuth > Application Registry. In that instance, create an OAuth API endpoint for external clients named Composio, set redirect URL to https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add, then return the generated client ID and client secret. Confirm that the instance accepts this callback URL.

verification.result: No RFC 7591 registration endpoint discovered; ServiceNow OAuth applications are created inside each target instance. No client was available to verify.

acquisition.human_action_required: An operator must sign in to the OpenAI API dashboard, create an API key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys (or the project's API Keys settings), and securely provide the resulting key for the connector. No browser form was submitted.

verification.result: OpenAI documents Bearer authentication with OPENAI_API_KEY; Nango independently classifies OpenAI as API_KEY and publishes no OAuth or registration URL. No key was available to verify.

alternatives.note: OpenAI auth metadata exposes account authorization/token endpoints, but no dynamic client registration endpoint; this is not the documented route for OpenAI API access and cannot be used without a pre-registered client.
